fields.subtitle: Family line
open: This is the Millbrook district family line. This is an exercise.
Thank you for calling. I will help you find where to go.
ask: Is your child on the bus 14 roster, and what is the child's grade?
Are you on the release card for this student?
say: Students are safe and being reunified at the church hall entrance on Elm Street.
Do not go to the crash site.
neverSay: Never name a student's condition or say who is hurt.
Never confirm a student's location to an unverified caller.
fields.escalate: Pass to the supervisor any caller who says they cannot reach the site, who is in distress or who names a custody dispute.
